create_AmazonPolarity_dataset: create an AmazonPolarity dataset instance for few-shot classification on Amazon review polarity
run_generate_k_shot_data: run the AmazonPolarity dataset to generate k-shot train dev and test splits
load_amazon_polarity_dataset: load the amazon_polarity HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of title content and label tuples
get_train_test_lines: get shuffled train and test line splits from the Amazon polarity dataset
